# Load data

```{r, include=FALSE}
load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/muscle_integrated.RData")

rm(Agca_snLLC_CTL, Agca_snLLC_LLC, Brown_scLLC_CTL, Brown_scLLC_2w, Brown_scLLC_2.5w, Brown_scLLC_3.5w, Kim_scB16F10_CTL, Kim_scB16F10_B16F10, Pryce_scC26_CTL, Pryce_scC26_C26, Pryce_scKPP_CTL, Pryce_scKPP_KPP, Zhang_snKIC_CTL, Zhang_snKIC_KIC, DEGs_sc_combined, all_genes)

muscle_combined <- sc_combined

rm(sc_combined)



load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/tumours_integrated.RData")

DefaultAssay(muscle_combined) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(tumours_combined) <- "RNA"
```


## Define CTLs and Tumour-bearing

```{r, include=FALSE}
ctl_samples <- c(
  "Agca_snLLC_CTL",
  "Brown_scLLC_CTL",
  "Kim_scB16F10_CTL",
  "Pryce_scC26_CTL",
  "Pryce_scKPP_CTL",
  "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"
)

early_tb_samples <- c(
  "Brown_scLLC_2w",
  "Brown_scLLC_2.5w"
)

endpoint_tb_samples <- c(
  "Agca_snLLC_LLC",
  "Brown_scLLC_3.5w",
  "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10",
  "Pryce_scC26_C26",
  "Pryce_scKPP_KPP",
  "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"
)



muscle_combined$condition <- NA

muscle_combined$condition[muscle_combined$orig.ident %in% ctl_samples] <- "Control"

muscle_combined$condition[muscle_combined$orig.ident %in% early_tb_samples] <- "Early tumour-bearing"

muscle_combined$condition[muscle_combined$orig.ident %in% endpoint_tb_samples] <- "Endpoint tumour-bearing"

rm(ctl_samples, early_tb_samples, endpoint_tb_samples)
```



# Define sender and receiver cell types

### TUMOUR SENDERS "Malignant cells", "Endothelial cells", "Cancer-associated fibroblasts", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Neutrophils", "B cells", "T cells", "NK cells"

### MUSCLE SENDERS "Satellite cells", "Myoblasts", "Myonuclei", "Endothelial cells", "vSMCs", "Pericytes", "FAPs", "Tenocytes", "Platelets", "Mast cells", "Dendritic cells", "Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Neutrophils", "B cells", "T cells", "NK cells", "Neural/glial cells", "Scwann cells"

### MUSCLE RECEIVERS "Myonuclei"


## Specify "Muscle" or "Tumour" in seurat objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
muscle_combined$seurat_clusters <- paste("Muscle", muscle_combined$seurat_clusters)
Idents(muscle_combined) <- muscle_combined$seurat_clusters

tumours_combined$seurat_clusters <- paste("Tumour", tumours_combined$seurat_clusters)
Idents(tumours_combined) <- tumours_combined$seurat_clusters
```


## Add in metadata about tissue type

```{r, include=FALSE}
muscle_combined$tissue <- "Muscle"

tumours_combined$tissue <- "Tumour"
```


## Combine muscle and tumour objects

## Extract the counts layer you want from the objects
```{r, include=FALSE}
muscle_combined_counts <- GetAssayData(muscle_combined[["RNA"]], layer = "data.SeuratProject", slot = "counts")

tumours_combined_counts <- GetAssayData(tumours_combined[["RNA"]], layer = "data", slot = "counts")



muscle_combined[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = muscle_combined_counts)

tumours_combined[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = tumours_combined_counts)



rm(muscle_combined_counts, tumours_combined_counts)
```


## Merge muscle and tumour

```{r, include=FALSE}
muscle_tumours_combined <- merge(
  muscle_combined,
  y = tumours_combined,
  add.cell.ids = c("Muscle", "Tumour")
)

rm(muscle_combined, tumours_combined)
```


## Normalize

```{r, include=FALSE}
muscle_tumours_combined <- NormalizeData(muscle_tumours_combined)
```


## Order Idents

```{r, include=FALSE}
muscle_tumours_combined_levels <- c("Tumour Malignant cells", "Tumour Endothelial cells", "Tumour Cancer-associated fibroblasts", "Tumour Monocytes/macrophages", "Tumour Neutrophils", "Tumour B cells", "Tumour T cells", "Tumour NK cells", "Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Platelets", "Muscle Mast cells", "Muscle Dendritic cells", "Muscle Monocytes", "Muscle Macrophages", "Muscle Neutrophils", "Muscle B cells", "Muscle T cells", "Muscle NK cells", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells")

muscle_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters <- factor(muscle_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters, levels = muscle_tumours_combined_levels)
                                  
Idents(muscle_tumours_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

rm(muscle_tumours_combined_levels)
```


## Identify sender and receiver cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(muscle_tumours_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

sender_cells <- c("Tumour Malignant cells", "Tumour Endothelial cells", "Tumour Cancer-associated fibroblasts", "Tumour Monocytes/macrophages", "Tumour Neutrophils", "Tumour B cells", "Tumour T cells", "Tumour NK cells", "Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Platelets", "Muscle Mast cells", "Muscle Dendritic cells", "Muscle Monocytes", "Muscle Macrophages", "Muscle Neutrophils", "Muscle B cells", "Muscle T cells", "Muscle NK cells", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells")

receiver_cells <- "Muscle Myonuclei"
```



# Load nichenet data (httpS://zenodo.org/record/7074291)

```{r, include=FALSE}
### LR network
lr_network <- readRDS("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/nichenet_databases/lr_network_mouse_21122021.rds")

### weighted networks (lr_sig is interactions and weights in LR signaling network, gr is interactions and weights in gene regulator network)
weighted_networks <- readRDS("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/nichenet_databases/weighted_networks_nsga2r_final_mouse.rds")

weighted_networks_lr = weighted_networks$lr_sig %>%
  inner_join(lr_network, by = c("from", "to"))

### ligand target matrix (probability that a ligand regulates gene expression in receiver cells)
ligand_target_matrix <- readRDS("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/nichenet_databases/ligand_target_matrix_nsga2r_final_mouse.rds")
```



# Get genes expressed from sender and receiver cells 

```{r, include=FALSE}
list_expressed_genes_sender = sender_cells %>%
  unique() %>%
  lapply(get_expressed_genes, muscle_tumours_combined, 0.10) # expressed in 10%

sender_genes = list_expressed_genes_sender %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()

receiver_genes = get_expressed_genes(receiver_cells, muscle_tumours_combined, pct = 0.10)

background_genes = receiver_genes %>%
  .[. %in% rownames(ligand_target_matrix)]
```



# Define gene set of interest (genes in receiver cells that are affected by ligands from the sender cells)

## Subset receiver cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
myonuclei <- subset(muscle_tumours_combined, idents = "Muscle Myonuclei")
```


## Differentially expressed receiver genes in receiver cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(myonuclei) <- "condition"

de_receiver_genes <- FindMarkers(myonuclei, ident.1 = "Endpoint tumour-bearing", ident.2 = "Control", min.pct = 0.10)

de_receiver_genes = de_receiver_genes %>%
  filter(p_val_adj <= 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) >= 0.2)

de_receiver_gene_names <- rownames(de_receiver_genes)

de_receiver_gene_names = de_receiver_gene_names %>%
  .[. %in% rownames(ligand_target_matrix)]
```


## Get list of genes involved in catbolism

```{r, include=FALSE}
bp_genesets_mouse <- msigdbr(db_species = "MM", species = "Mus musculus", collection = "M5", subcollection = "GO:BP")

proteasome_genes <- bp_genesets_mouse %>%
  filter(gs_name %in% c("GOBP_PROTEASOME_MEDIATED_UBIQUITIN_DEPENDENT_PROTEIN_CATABOLIC_PROCESS", "GOBP_PROTEASOMAL_PROTEIN_CATABOLIC_PROCESS"))
proteasome_gene_list <- unique(proteasome_genes$gene_symbol)

autophagy_genes <- bp_genesets_mouse %>%
  filter(gs_name %in% c("GOBP_MACROAUTOPHAGY", "GOBP_MICROAUTOPHAGY"))
autophagy_gene_list <- unique(autophagy_genes$gene_symbol)

upr_genes <- bp_genesets_mouse %>%
  filter(gs_name == "GOBP_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_UNFOLDED_PROTEIN")
upr_gene_list <- unique(upr_genes$gene_symbol)

catabolism_gene_list <- unique(c(
  proteasome_gene_list,
  autophagy_gene_list,
  upr_gene_list
))

rm(proteasome_genes, proteasome_gene_list, autophagy_genes, autophagy_gene_list, upr_genes, upr_gene_list)
```


## Filter de_receiver_gene_names for those in catabolism_gene_list

```{r, include=FALSE}
catabolic_de_receiver_genes <- de_receiver_gene_names[
  de_receiver_gene_names %in% catabolism_gene_list
]
```


## Identify potential ligands in the sender cell population that bind to receptor(s) in the receiver cell population

```{r, include=FALSE}
ligands = lr_network %>%
  pull(from) %>%
  unique()

receptors = lr_network %>%
  pull(to) %>%
  unique()

expressed_ligands = intersect(ligands, sender_genes)
expressed_receptors = intersect(receptors, receiver_genes)

potential_ligands = lr_network %>%
  filter(from %in% expressed_ligands & to %in% expressed_receptors) %>%
  pull(from) %>%
  unique()
```



# NicheNet ligand activity analysis (rank ligands based on presence of target genes)

### NOTE - AUPR (area under the precision-recall curve) used to rank ligand activity (between ligand's target prediction and observed transcriptional response)

```{r, include=FALSE}
ligand_activities = predict_ligand_activities(geneset = catabolic_de_receiver_genes, background_expressed_genes = background_genes, ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix, potential_ligands = potential_ligands)

# Arrange aupr from highest to lowest
ligand_activities = arrange(ligand_activities, -aupr_corrected)

# To get all ligands
ligand_activities_genes <- unique(ligand_activities$test_ligand)
```



# Infer the ligands with the highest regulatory potentials

```{r, include=FALSE}
# What ligands lead to the expression of target genes
active_ligand_target_links_df = ligand_activities_genes %>%
  lapply(get_weighted_ligand_target_links, geneset = catabolic_de_receiver_genes, ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  drop_na()

# Matrix of ligands (column names) and target genes (rownames) interaction weights

quantile_value <- quantile(active_ligand_target_links_df$weight, probs = 0.90) # This takes the top 10% strongest regulatory links instead of using an arbitrary cutoff!

active_ligand_target_links = prepare_ligand_target_visualization(ligand_target_df = active_ligand_target_links_df, ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix, cutoff = quantile_value)
```


## Heatmap ligands --> target genes

### Filter for ligands expressed in sender cells with an average expression >= 0.25 in >= 25% of cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Extract log-normalized data
sender_mat <- Seurat::GetAssayData(muscle_tumours_combined, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[ligand_activities_genes, ]

# Compute average expression and % expressing
sender_expr_stats <- data.frame(
  ligand      = ligand_activities_genes,
  avg_exp     = Matrix::rowMeans(sender_mat), # average log-normalized expression
  pct_express = Matrix::rowSums(sender_mat > 0) / ncol(sender_mat) # fraction of cells with >0
)

# Filter by thresholds (example: avg >= 0.25 and pct >= 25%)
sender_expressed_ligands <- sender_expr_stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_exp >= 0.25, pct_express >= 0.25)

sender_expr_stats   # all ligands with values
sender_expressed_ligands <- sender_expressed_ligands$ligand # ligands meeting thresholds
```

### Heatmap with ligands confirmed to be expressed in sender cells

```{r}
order_ligands = intersect(ligand_activities_genes, colnames(active_ligand_target_links)) %>% 
  rev() %>%
  make.names()

order_targets = active_ligand_target_links_df$target %>%
  unique() %>%
  intersect(rownames(active_ligand_target_links)) %>%
  make.names()

rownames(active_ligand_target_links) = rownames(active_ligand_target_links) %>%
  make.names()

colnames(active_ligand_target_links) = colnames(active_ligand_target_links) %>%
  make.names()

vis_ligand_target = active_ligand_target_links[order_targets, order_ligands] %>%
  t()

p_ligand_target_network <- vis_ligand_target %>%
  make_heatmap_ggplot(
    "Ligands",
    "Predicted target genes",
    color = "red",
    legend_position = "right",
    x_axis_position = "bottom",
    legend_title = "Regulatory potential"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.8)
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "grey95",
    high = "red",
    limits = c(0, 0.3)
  )

p_ligand_target_network
```

### write.csv of ligands x predicted target genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(
  vis_ligand_target,
  file = "catabolism_to_myonuclei_regulatory_potential.csv",
  row.names = TRUE
)
```


```{r}
ligand_summary <- data.frame(

ligand_summary$aupr_corrected <-
```

# Receptors receiving signals from most active ligands

### Specify receptors for the "Ezr", "Mfge8", "Calm1", "Tgfb3", "Lamc1", "Cd9", "Col17a1", "Col9a1" ligands

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Your ligands of interest
top_ligands <- c("Ezr", "Mfge8", "Calm1", "Tgfb3", "Lamc1", "Cd9", "Col17a1", "Col9a1")

# Extract ligand–receptor table from CellChatDB
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse
lr_pairs <- CellChatDB$interaction

# Filter to your ligands
lr_subset <- lr_pairs %>%
  dplyr::filter(ligand %in% top_ligands)

# View the receptors associated with your ligands
target_receptors <- unique(lr_subset$receptor)
target_receptors
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
target_receptors <- c("Tgfbr1", "Tgfbr2", "Acvr1b", "Acvr1c", "Acvr1", "Itga1", "Itgb1", "Itga2", "Itga3", "Itga6", "Itga7", "Itga9", "Itga10", "Itga11", "Itgav", "Itgb8", "Itgb4", "Cd44", "Sdc1", "Sdc4", "Sv2a", "Sv2b", "Sv2c", "Gp6", "Dag1")
```

### Filter for receptors expressed in receiver cells with an average expression >= 0.2 in >= 10% of cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Extract log-normalized data for receiver cells
receiver_mat <- Seurat::GetAssayData(muscle_tumours_combined, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")[target_receptors, ]

# Compute average expression and % of cells expressing each receptor
receiver_expr_stats <- data.frame(
  receptor     = target_receptors,
  avg_exp      = Matrix::rowMeans(receiver_mat),             # mean expression
  pct_express  = Matrix::rowSums(receiver_mat > 0) / ncol(receiver_mat)  # fraction of cells expressing
)

# Apply thresholds (>=0.1 expression AND >=10% of cells)
receiver_expressed_receptors <- receiver_expr_stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_exp >= 0.2, pct_express >= 0.10)

# Extract receptor names passing thresholds
receiver_expressed_receptors <- receiver_expressed_receptors$receptor
```

### Get matrix of interaction weights between ligands and receptors

```{r, include=FALSE}
lr_network_top <- lr_network %>%
  filter(from %in% ligand_activities_genes & to %in% receiver_expressed_receptors) %>%
  distinct(from, to)

lr_network_top_df_large = weighted_networks_lr %>%
  filter(from %in% ligand_activities_genes & to %in% receiver_expressed_receptors)

lr_network_top_df = lr_network_top_df_large %>%
  spread("from", "weight", fill = 0)

lr_network_top_matrix = lr_network_top_df %>%
  select(-to) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  magrittr::set_rownames(lr_network_top_df$to)

lr_network_top_matrix <- as.matrix(lr_network_top_matrix)
mode(lr_network_top_matrix) <- "numeric"
lr_network_top_matrix[is.na(lr_network_top_matrix)] <- 0

dist_ligands = dist(lr_network_top_matrix, method = "binary")
hclust_ligands = hclust(dist_ligands, method = "ward.D2")
order_ligands_receptor = hclust_ligands$label[hclust_ligands$order]

dist_receptors = dist(lr_network_top_matrix, method = "binary")
hclust_receptors = hclust(dist_receptors, method = "ward.D2")
order_receptors = hclust_receptors$label[hclust_receptors$order]

order_receptors = order_receptors %>%
  intersect(rownames(lr_network_top_matrix))
order_ligands_receptor = order_ligands_receptor %>%
  intersect(colnames(lr_network_top_matrix))
```

### Clean lr_networs_top_matrix to pass through heatmap

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Remove non-numeric metadata columns
lr_network_top_matrix_clean <- lr_network_top_matrix[, !colnames(lr_network_top_matrix) %in% c("database", "source")]

# Collapse duplicate rows by summing
lr_network_top_matrix_clean <- aggregate(lr_network_top_matrix_clean,
                                         by = list(Receptor = gsub("\\.1$", "", rownames(lr_network_top_matrix_clean))),
                                         FUN = sum)

# Set row names to receptor names and remove the extra column
rownames(lr_network_top_matrix_clean) <- lr_network_top_matrix_clean$Receptor
lr_network_top_matrix_clean <- lr_network_top_matrix_clean[, -1]

# Make sure it is a numeric matrix
lr_network_top_matrix_clean <- as.matrix(lr_network_top_matrix_clean)
mode(lr_network_top_matrix_clean) <- "numeric"
```

```{r}
### Specify ligands and receptors of interest
my_ligands <- c("Ezr", "Mfge8", "Calm1", "Tgfb3", "Lamc1", "Cd9", "Col17a1", "Col9a1")
my_receptors <- c("Tgfbr1", "Tgfbr2", "Acvr1b", "Acvr1c", "Acvr1", "Itga1", "Itgb1", "Itga2", "Itga3", "Itga6", "Itga7", "Itga9", "Itga10", "Itga11", "Itgav", "Itgb8", "Itgb4", "Cd44", "Sdc1", "Sdc4", "Sv2a", "Sv2b", "Sv2c", "Gp6", "Dag1")

# Ensure these exist in the cleaned matrix
ligands_in_matrix <- intersect(my_ligands, colnames(lr_network_top_matrix_clean))
receptors_in_matrix <- intersect(my_receptors, rownames(lr_network_top_matrix_clean))

### Subset the matrix
vis_ligand_receptor_network <- lr_network_top_matrix_clean[receptors_in_matrix, ligands_in_matrix, drop = FALSE]

# Make names safe for plotting
rownames(vis_ligand_receptor_network) <- make.names(rownames(vis_ligand_receptor_network))
colnames(vis_ligand_receptor_network) <- make.names(colnames(vis_ligand_receptor_network))

### Transpose if needed (ligands on y-axis, receptors on x-axis)
vis_ligand_receptor_network <- t(vis_ligand_receptor_network)

# Ensure numeric
mode(vis_ligand_receptor_network) <- "numeric"

### Plot heatmap (with x_name and y_name specified)
p_ligand_receptor_network <- vis_ligand_receptor_network %>%
  make_heatmap_ggplot(
    x_name = "Receptors",
    y_name = "Ligands",
    color = "red",
    legend_position = "right",
    x_axis_position = "bottom",
    legend_title = "Prior interaction potential"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "grey95",
    high = "red",
    limits = c(0, 1.5)  # set the range from 0 to 1.5
  ) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.8))

p_ligand_receptor_network
```



# Check receptor expression

## Subset cell types

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(muscle_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

myonuclei <- subset(muscle_combined, idents = "Myonuclei")
```


## Tgfbr1 in myonuclei

```{r, include=FALSE}
myonuclei_Tgfbr1 <- AverageExpression(
  myonuclei,
  features = "Tgfbr1",
  group.by = c("experiment", "condition"),
  layer = "data"
)$RNA
```


## Tgfbr2 in myonuclei

```{r, include=FALSE}
myonuclei_Tgfbr2 <- AverageExpression(
  myonuclei,
  features = "Tgfbr2",
  group.by = c("experiment", "condition"),
  layer = "data"
)$RNA
```


## write.csv

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(myonuclei_Tgfbr1,
          "myonuclei_Tgfbr1.csv",
          row.names = TRUE)

write.csv(myonuclei_Tgfbr2,
          "myonuclei_Tgfbr2.csv",
          row.names = TRUE)
```



# Receptors expression in combined cell types (pre-revisions)

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Create combined grouping variable
myonuclei$cond_sample <- paste(
  myonuclei$condition,
  myonuclei$orig.ident,
  sep = "_"
)

# Set identity to this new grouping
Idents(myonuclei) <- "cond_sample"

# Genes of interest
receptors_genes_myonuclei <- c("Tgfbr1", "Tgfbr2", "Itga1", "Itgb1", "Itga6", "Itgav")

# Get mean expression
avg_receptors_exp_myonuclei <- AverageExpression(
  myonuclei,
```

# Confirm TGFb1 signaling in myonuclei by looking at expression of downstream signaling

## Find markers 

```{r}
Idents(myonuclei) <- "condition"

# From msigdbr HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING
tgfb1_gene_list <- c("Nog", "Cdkn1c", "Fnta", "Skil", "Xiap", "Ifngr2", "Hdac1", "Slc20a1", "Smad1", "Bmpr2", "Rhoa", "Smad7", "Klf10", "Tgif1", "Smad3", "Hipk2", "Cdk9", "Smad6", "Ncor2", "Bmpr1a", "Map3k7", "Bcar3", "Ube2d3", "Rab31", "Wwtr1", "Smurf1", "Ppp1r15a", "Pmepa1", "Trim33", "Arid4b", "Acvr1", "Apc", "Bmp2", "Ctnnb1", "Cdh1", "Eng", "Fkbp1a", "Id1", "Id2", "Id3", "Junb", "Furin", "Serpine1", "Ski", "Sptbn1", "Tgfb1", "Tgfbr1", "Thbs1", "Tjp1", "Ltbp2", "Ppm1a")

# FindMarkers
tgfb1_early_genes <- FindMarkers(
  myonuclei,
  ident.1 = "Early tumour-bearing",
  ident.2 = "Control",
  features = tgfb1_gene_list,
  min.pct = 0
)

tgfb1_end_genes <- FindMarkers(
  myonuclei,
  ident.1 = "Endpoint tumour-bearing",
  ident.2 = "Control",
  features = tgfb1_gene_list,
  min.pct = 0
)

# Merge with gene list and keep gene column
tgfb1_early_genes <- tgfb1_gene_list %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames("gene") %>%
  left_join(
    tgfb1_early_genes %>% rownames_to_column("gene"),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  # Replace NAs with 0
  mutate(across(c(avg_log2FC, p_val, p_val_adj), ~replace_na(., 0)))

tgfb1_end_genes <- tgfb1_gene_list %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames("gene") %>%
  left_join(
    tgfb1_end_genes %>% rownames_to_column("gene"),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(avg_log2FC, p_val, p_val_adj), ~replace_na(., 0)))

tgfb1_early_genes

tgfb1_end_genes
```


## Plot 

```{r}
# Prepare data
tgfb1_early_genes <- tgfb1_early_genes %>%
  mutate(
    gene = gene,
    p_fill = ifelse(p_val_adj > 0.05, NA, p_val_adj)  # NA for non-significant
  )

tgfb1_end_genes <- tgfb1_end_genes %>%
  mutate(
    gene = gene,
    p_fill = ifelse(p_val_adj > 0.05, NA, p_val_adj)  # NA for non-significant
  )



# Set avg_log2FC = 0 for non-significant genes
tgfb1_early_genes <- tgfb1_early_genes %>%
  mutate(
    avg_log2FC_plot = ifelse(p_val_adj > 0.05, 0, avg_log2FC),
    p_fill = ifelse(p_val_adj > 0.05, NA, p_val_adj)
  )

tgfb1_end_genes <- tgfb1_end_genes %>%
  mutate(
    avg_log2FC_plot = ifelse(p_val_adj > 0.05, 0, avg_log2FC),
    p_fill = ifelse(p_val_adj > 0.05, NA, p_val_adj)
  )



# Plot
# Plot Early
ggplot(tgfb1_early_genes, aes(x = gene, y = avg_log2FC_plot, fill = p_fill)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "blue",
    high = "red",
    na.value = "black",
    trans = scales::log10_trans(),
    name = "Adjusted p-value"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-10, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "TGFb1 signaling (Early tumour-bearing)",
    x = "",
    y = "avg_log2FC (significant genes only)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Plot Endpoint
ggplot(tgfb1_end_genes, aes(x = gene, y = avg_log2FC_plot, fill = p_fill)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "blue",
    high = "red",
    na.value = "black",
    trans = scales::log10_trans(),
    name = "Adjusted p-value"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "TGFb1 signaling (Endpoint tumour-bearing)",
    x = "",
    y = "avg_log2FC (significant genes only)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

# Ligand-to-target gene signaling paths

## Find target genes from highly expressed ligands

### High regulatory ligands "Tgfb3"

```{r, include=FALSE}
# From Regulatory potential heatmap
ligands_tgfb3 = "Tgfb3"

# Subset active_ligand_target_links_df and get unique targets
targets_tgfb3 <- active_ligand_target_links_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(ligand %in% ligands_tgfb3) %>%
  dplyr::pull(target) %>%
  unique()

# Chose specific target(s) because the graph won't work well with too many
targets_tgfb3 <- c("Trim63", "Fbxo32")
```


## Plot gene regulatory interactions

```{r}
# ---- 1. Calculate the TGFb3 signaling network ----
# weighted_networks = your precomputed weighted network object
# ---- 1. Build signaling network ----
tgfb3_signaling_network <- get_ligand_signaling_path(
  ligand_tf_matrix = ligand_target_matrix,
  ligands_all = ligands_tgfb3,
  targets_all = targets_tgfb3,
  weighted_networks = weighted_networks
)

# ---- 2. Normalize edge weights (optional) ----
tgfb3_signaling_network_min_max <- tgfb3_signaling_network
tgfb3_signaling_network_min_max$sig <- tgfb3_signaling_network_min_max$sig %>%
  dplyr::mutate(weight = (weight - min(weight)) / (max(weight) - min(weight)) + 0.75)

# ---- 3. Prepare edges and nodes ----
edges_df <- tgfb3_signaling_network_min_max$sig[, c("from", "to", "weight")]
nodes_df <- data.frame(name = unique(c(edges_df$from, edges_df$to)))
nodes_df$type <- ifelse(nodes_df$name %in% ligands_tgfb3, "ligand", "target")

# ---- 4. Build igraph object ----
tgfb3_igraph <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges_df[, c("from", "to")],
  vertices = nodes_df,
  directed = TRUE
)

# ---- 5. Plot dendrogram ----
ggraph(tgfb3_igraph, layout = "dendrogram") +
  geom_edge_diagonal(alpha = 0.5, color = "grey50") +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = type), size = 3) +
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = name),
    size = 3,
    repel = TRUE,
    hjust = 1
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# ---- 6. Save TIFF ----
ggsave("dendrogram_myonuclei_catabolism.tiff", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 1200)
ggsave("dendrogram_myonuclei_catabolism.eps", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 1200)
```
